company.name: Raft
company.shortDescription: Raft is an intelligent logistics platform that automates the process for freight forwarders and customs brokers.
company.description: Raft is a smart logistics platform that automates the freight process for complete control and visibility. Raft's solution will use artificial intelligence to understand, triage, and act on incoming shipment data, saving HBI’s operators countless hours chasing information, manually keying into systems, and reconciling downstream systems. The platform’s real-time, continuous processing will enable HBI operators to handle shipments more quickly and with more certainty for their customers.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $30,000,000, or 62.67% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,369,328 to $168,920,806, a 50.13x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 28 (-33 over 90 days) and market heat at 62 (-3).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
